justification: Monitor silently lost new council documents. Standard: one except block and the exit decision; no new query.

pre_impl.existing_data: dcp_chapter_registry.hub_last_pdf_count, already written by this loop
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: If several new documents and only one fails, the count still stays put so all reappear next run; registered ones match by URL then
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies from the next monitor run onward; no stored rows change

functions.name: run_monitor
functions.input: registry rows and hub scrape results per council
functions.output: results dict with the new register_failed list
functions.if_none: no new documents means the list stays empty and nothing changes

queries.purpose: move the stored hub document count
queries.where_clause: council = %s AND council_page_url IS NOT NULL AND is_active = TRUE
queries.if_wrong: unchanged query; now skipped after a failed registration

break_it.scenario: _auto_register_chapter raises on a database insert for a new hub document
break_it.what_happens: Before: printed, run green, document lost. Now: exit 1 with NOT ADDED line

break_it.scenario: The count update runs anyway after a failed registration
break_it.what_happens: Next run would no longer see the new document

break_it.scenario: A failing registration repeats every night for the same document
break_it.what_happens: The monitor pages every night until someone fixes it
break_it.how: Intended: loud and repeated beats silent

falsifiable_check.observed_red: Ran the new test against unfixed r2_monitor.py: 2 failed, 1 passed (the good-registration case).
